# Hashbrown PR checklist (factory gate)

Copy into PR review. Approve only if all pass.

- [ ] Matches plan / issue scope (no drive-by)
- [ ] Contact CTA path OK (if UI)
- [ ] No public prices / pack catalog / pricing route
- [ ] Grep clean: € EUR USD precio /pricing 297
- [ ] No secrets in diff
- [ ] PR size sane (split if huge dump)
- [ ] Build/lint noted or green (when app exists)

Verdict: APPROVE | CHANGES REQUESTED
